issue.title: :// to use command name for scheme
issue.body:
## Checklist

- [x] I've searched for similar feature requests.

---

## Enhancement request

`://` for `use command name for scheme`, like this:
```
http ://example.com 
--> http://example.com
https ://example.com
 --> https://example.com
```

---

## Problem it solves

This will make requesting from clipboard more easy, it's just putting space.
